strengths: Toddler-scale gifts are concrete and unsentimental, giving the gratitude topic real texture.
The distinction between thankfulness as simple obedience and thankfulness as performance fits the baseline voice well.
Orthodox mode is clearly embodied through Holy Trinity, the home as a little church, icons, mercy, forgiveness, Holy Spirit, and Resurrection joy.
grader_note: Approved on independent regrade. This is the strongest of the three because the ordinary toddler details, spiritual distinction, Orthodox home imagery, and final praise integrate cleanly.
